items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (APSB26-92)
items.summary: This update resolves a critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVE-2026-71362) that could allow unauthenticated attackers to hijack customer accounts and escalate privileges. It also addresses several other high, medium, and low severity vulnerabilities.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (APSB26-73)
items.summary: Adobe released a security update resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes (CVE-2026-53787) allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution. Amasty released a fix in version 4.0.0.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-45247) in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, which could lead to remote code execution via a crafted cookie. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12).

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API, named PolyShell, allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files disguised as images, potentially leading to remote code execution or account takeover. Adobe released a fix in Magento 2.4.9, but older supported versions remain vulnerable without an isolated patch.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVE-2026-34646) in Adobe Commerce allows remote, unauthenticated attackers to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access. Adobe published this vulnerability with a CVSS 3.1 base score of 7.5.
